Scenario 18: Update an existing Workflow returns "Bad request" response
  Tags: ['@team:DataDog/workflow-automation-dev']
  Given  there is a valid "workflow" in the system
  And  new "UpdateWorkflow" request
  And  request contains "workflow_id" parameter from "workflow.data.id"
  And  body with value {"data": {"attributes": {"name": "Too many characters in description", "description": "", "spec": {}}, "id": "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222", "type": "workflows"}}
  When  the request is sent
  Then  the response status is 400 Bad request
